From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & MAP — FinPay evaluation

Hi Lindsey / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

Call recap:
- Use case: FinPay plans to add automated invoice summarization and LLM-powered customer support replies for high-volume merchants (primarily US-based).
- Primary decision criteria: latency under 300ms 95p, predictable cost per 1k requests, and enterprise-grade audit logging + SOC2 evidence.
- Pilot scope: 30-day pilot covering 2 merchant flows (invoices + support), expected ~500k tokens/day during pilot.

Proposed MAP (attached: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Pilot kickoff — week of Nov 29 (deliverables: sample prompts, test dataset, baseline perf) — owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Lindsey (FinPay)
2) Security review — week of Dec 6 (deliverables: SOC2 summary, security call, questionnaire responses) — owner: FinPay security / Redwood (Rishi)
3) Procurement / commercial — target PO by Dec 20 (deliverables: SOW, pricing, PO) — owner: Tom / Procurement
4) Production roll-out planning — Jan 2027

Asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the economic buyer (we heard CFO Raj Patel) and the procurement timeline?
- Who will own the security questionnaire and do you have a preferred format?
- Can we schedule 30m next week to review the MAP and agree milestones?

Attaching: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft).

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite once I hear back on availability.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few quick notes: 

- Confirmed: economic buyer is Raj Patel (CFO). I'll loop him in when we get closer to procurement but he wants a short exec summary ahead of any PO.
- Procurement: our typical timeline is 4-8 weeks once SOW + pricing are finalized; current expectation is end-of-year PO but could slip depending on security review.
- Security/legal: Tom (cc'd) is lead for procurement/security intake. He will own the questionnaire and schedule the security call.
- Data residency: we need confirmation that logs/audit trails remain in US regions for pilot.

I added Tom directly so he can engage procurement/security. Happy to join the MAP review next week — my availability Tues/Wed afternoon.

Thanks,
Lindsey
Head of Product Operations | FinPay
Lindsey.Carter@finpay.com
